sections.title: Jeff Silver Platinum Award
sections.sublabel: Recognizing Achievement in the Collision Repair Industry
body: First presented in 2009, the Jeff Silver Platinum Individual Award honors Jeff Silver, a visionary leader known for his commitment to technical training and excellence within the collision repair industry.

sections.title: Platinum Individual Nomination Form for 2025 Performance Year

cards.title: Purpose
cards.body: This award recognizes individuals who demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning, professional growth, and advancing industry standards through ongoing training and development.

cards.title: Eligibility
cards.body: This award will be bestowed upon a select individual that meets the following requirements:
listItems: Holds a long term (defined as at least five consecutive years) I-CAR Platinum Individual designation
Trains beyond the minimum requirement to maintain the designation
Available for a member of any industry segment that meets criteria
cards.footer: Please note all current I-CAR employees are not eligible to earn this award. This includes I-CAR full-time and part-time instructors.

cards.title: Nominating Procedure
cards.bodyHtml: Complete this form and submit it prior to July 31, 2026. For questions, email i‑car.events.dept@i-car.com.

cards.title: Presentation of Award
cards.bodyHtml: The award will be presented during 2026 SEMA Week in Las Vegas, on <time datetime="2026-11-03">Tuesday, November 3</time>, at the Collision Industry Red Carpet Awards.
